context_for_next_testing_agent: Parent Student Dashboard fully tested and working. This is a NEW page at /parent/student-dashboard that replicates the Student Dashboard for parents. Key features: read-only banner with child name, child selector buttons, stats cards (Cursos, Tareas, Asistencias, Mensajes), task progress bar, attendance progress bar, student profile card, courses list, tasks list, hero carousel. API endpoint /api/parent/dashboard?student_id=X returns full dashboard data including task_progress, upcoming_tasks, attendance_summary, recent_announcements. All navigation goes to parent routes (/parent/courses etc), not student routes.
